sources.title: Qwen
sources.snippet: Qwen Studio is an AI assistant for everyone, powered by the Qwen series models. It's free to use, open to all, and ready to help with creativity, collaboration, and endless possibilities.

sources.title: Bare-Corporation · GitHub
sources.snippet: Bare-AI is a Context-Primed CLI Wrapper for bare-ai-cli and google gemini cli in technical terms, we have engineered a Runtime Environment that forces a general-purpose AI (Gemini in this example) to behave like a specific employee (Bare-AI) every time it boots up.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
sources.snippet: Diverse Model Ecosystem Easily experience and quickly access Alibaba Cloud's latest foundational models (FM), including Qwen-Max, Qwen-Plus, Qwen-Turbo, Qwen-VL, and the Wan series.

sources.title: Bare-AI | Sovereign AI. Absolute Control.
sources.snippet: Sovereign AI. Absolute Control. Bare-AI is a Sovereign-first AI Platform. One open command-line interface is your single entry point to every major model — cloud and local. Bring your own provider keys, or tap the Council to run any model (and multi-model debates) on one shared key, with pooled access and transparent per-token pricing. Membership unlocks lower rates across the board.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: We are officially releasing Qwen 3.8-Max, the most capable model in the Qwen family to date. This also marks the first time we will open-source the weights of a Qwen-Max-class model. Built upon the architectural foundation of Qwen 3.5, Qwen 3.8-Max scales to 2.4 trillion parameters, delivering comprehensive improvements across coding, work, research, and long-horizon tasks.
